title: Polynomial-time decision from a verdict characterization
statement: Let $e$ be a Boolean exactness flag and let $L$ be a language of Boolean words. If a word $z$ belongs to $L$ exactly when the machine’s verdict on $z$ with flag $e$ is true, then the circuit-evaluation machine with flag $e$ decides $L$ in time $12(n+1)^2$ on every input of length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: For every Boolean word $z$, $z\in L$ if and only if the verdict with flag $e$ on $z$ is true
